## Software packages

In the module we will use the following software packages:

- **R**:
  - [PriceIndices](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/PriceIndices/index.html)
  - [IndexNumR](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/IndexNumR/index.html)
- **Python**:
  - [PyIndexNum](https://pypi.org/project/pyindexnum/) - **WARNING**: Still in beta status


## Notebooks

Jupyter notebooks will be loaded in a dedicated folder of the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/UN-Task-Team-for-Scanner-Data/brazil-workshop-on-use-of-ads/tree/multilateral/notebooks). You can load them directly in Google Colab.
